newsitem.title: JAPAN: Bank of Yokohama sets up securities arm.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Yokohama sets up securities arm.

text.p: Bank of Yokohama Ltd said on Wednesday that it would set up a fully-owned securities arm today if it completes the procedure.
It is the first securities arm set up by a Japanese regional bank, and the new company, BOY Securities Co Ltd, is expected to start operations in November, a bank spokesman said.
The company, capitalised at 20 billion yen, is expected to have about 40 management and employees. It will be headquartered in Yokohama, south of Tokyo, and will set up a branch in Tokyo, he added.
